look_here_first: Moist-ground sedge with moderately broad leaves and plump perigynia ending in a short but distinct beak.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Carex species are often separated by perigynium shape, beak, venation, and spike arrangement.

lookalikes.differences: Broader-leaved and more robust than C. texensis; lacks the broad white winged perigynia of C. tetrastachya.
